description.value: U Town Hot Pot is a Chinese hot pot restaurant in Richmond, BC, located at 8328 Capstan Way in what appears to be a multi-unit commercial development. Hot pot dining is an interactive communal experience where diners cook meat, vegetables, and other ingredients in a shared simmering broth at the table. Richmond's Capstan Way corridor sits near the Canada Line and is part of a growing mixed-use neighbourhood, making it accessible to cyclists exploring the city's dining scene.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 15m; rack at 47m.
